caption:
Zelenskyy compares Trump calling Putin a friend to befriending Hitler in WW2

Volodymyr Zelenskyy · World

Ukraine's president calls the comments strange and urges Washington to increase pressure on Moscow. Overnight, Nato fighter jets and an interceptor drone were scrambled in Latvia after a drone briefly entered its airspace near the Russian border, the army said. Several countries bordering the conflict have reported incursions or drone and missile crashes since February 2022.

Reported by The Guardian; South China Morning Post.
